description: Check exact package versions against the Aris knowledge graph's CVEs and advisories. Read versions from the lockfile when there is one, since manifests hold ranges. Returns per package: vulnerabilities with severity, CVSS, affected and fixed versions, and whether it is exploited in the wild. possibleMatches are fuzzy name matches; verify before acting. 1 cent per package.

version.description: An exact version, not a range.

name: aris_check_dependencies
title: Check dependencies for vulnerabilities
